title: Mixed uses of “above” in quality, service, and usability comments
summary: This topic is lexically noisy, combining praise about quality or dealer service, a usability remark about limited finger room, and one explicit complaint that unspecified problems spoil the car.

negative.summary: The only clear negative example says that problems with the vehicle spoil the overall experience.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments span higher-than-advertised fuel use, quality or equipment described as above expectations, dealer staff going above and beyond, limited finger access in one area, and an unrelated color-change remark.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, so the sentiment evidence for this topic is limited.
The cluster mixes unrelated subjects tied by the word 'above' rather than one coherent product issue.
Several fragments are too short or lack context to determine whether they express praise, criticism, or neither.
